text:
You hold me in your hands

and read me like a book.

You know what I don't

and tell me the things I don't tell myself.

I learn more of myself in you than in myself.

You are like a miracle at every hour,

like a pain with no place.

If you weren't a woman you'd be my friend.

Sometimes I want to tell you about women

I pursue off to one side of you.

You are like forgiveness

and I am like your son.

How kind your eyes are when you're with me!

How distant and absent you become

when I sacrifice you to solitude!

Sweet as your name, as a fig,

you wait for me in your love until I arrive.

You are like my house,

you are like my death, my love.

translation.title: You Hold Me in Your Hands
